segments.text:
The aduerſaries themſelues, although
they be very deſirous rather to follow their owne opinion thā the trueth, cānot interpret the words of the Lorde without the helpe of a figure. And I ſhew that in the Sacrament of the Euchariſt it is not lawfull for them to pronounce of it, This is my bodie. Let them be aſhamed therefore to blame vs for the which they themſelues may iuſtly & of due deſert be accuſed. Moreouer the very definitiō of a ſacrament, that it is the ſigne of an holy thing, & a viſible forme of inuiſible grace dooth moſt of all defend our opinion. For by that commō receaued definition it is brought to paſſe that thoſe thinges which be ſeene in the Euchariſt be ſignes of the bodie and bloud of the Lord, vnleſſe we will blot the Euchariſt it ſelfe out of the number of the Sacraments.
